agent_explanation: Shrunk 1s emergency at t=31 on N preempts EW green (EW yellow forced at step 31) and shortens subsequent cycle. The controller's yellow countdown is not properly reset after the emergency preemption, so the later NS yellow that starts at step 104 is truncated to 4s (steps 104-107 yellow, step 108 already all-red) instead of required 6s, violating yellow_duration on approaches 0 and 2. Removing the emergency eliminates the desync and restores full 6s yellow.
